findings.title: Priority inheritance working: meteo raised from 10 to 30 while bus_mgr waited
findings.root_cause: bus_mgr waited up to 55 ms for a lock held by meteo, but the kernel raised meteo from priority 10 to 30 for the duration (events #15861), so no medium-priority thread could delay it. This is the desired behaviour, shown as evidence that the fix works.
findings.fix: None needed. Keep critical sections short; the wait of 55 ms is bounded by the owner's critical-section length.
